The connected platform

One workflow, from first call to follow-up.

The suite is being built as a set of connected, role-specific tools for patients, clinicians and practice teams—not a stack of isolated point solutions.

Phase 1 · Pilot foundation

The core clinic experience, built for one login, role-based access and one connected operational picture.

AI Voice Front Desk

Answers missed calls, supports scheduling and routes urgent or complex needs to the right person.

INSNAPP Medical

Matches canceled appointment slots with waiting patients, with EHR write-back required before a recovery counts.

24H Doctor

Supports continuous care programs with a human care team, structured interactions and clinically governed escalation.

Exam-Room Scribe

Turns visit context into a structured draft while keeping the clinician responsible for review and sign-off.

Billing Review

Vivian’s review screen routes each claim by payer track and blocks export until a human signs off.

Practice Ops Dashboard

Brings schedule recovery, care-program activity, call handling and review queues into one operating view.

Patient Mobile Experience

One bilingual patient-facing place for earlier-slot offers, countdowns, accept or decline, pool preferences and continuous-care interactions.

Earlier opening availableA Spanish-and-English, mobile-first path from offer to confirmed appointment.
Product roadmap

Prove the platform. Prove the value. Then scale.

The roadmap keeps the pilot focused while preparing the shared infrastructure needed for additional clinics.

PHASE 1

Pilot foundation

Connect the core patient, clinical and practice workflows.

  • Five core care and operations modules
  • Patient mobile experience
  • Practice-wide operations view
  • Multi-tenant architecture
PHASE 2

Revenue protection

Reduce leakage and follow-up work across the patient journey.

  • Referral management
  • Prior authorization assistant
  • Patient recall engine
  • Shared EHR and notification plumbing
PHASE 3

Multi-clinic scale

Extend the platform for broader MSO operations.

  • Patient payments and collections
  • Telehealth, if pilot needs support it
  • Care-team workforce scheduling
  • Clinic-to-clinic operations

About Dr. Morgan

Clinical training. Builder’s perspective.

Mohammed M. Morgan, M.D. is a physician-entrepreneur with more than two decades across healthcare and business development. He earned his M.B.Ch.B. from the University of Alexandria, completed a cardiology post-doctoral fellowship at Massachusetts General Hospital and Harvard Medical School, and served as an endocrine research fellow at MGH.

His operating work spans healthcare ventures, international patient services and cross-border business development. He is now building CURAVIA—Coordinated Unified Recovery, Access, Visits, Intelligence & Advocacy—as an AI-powered MSO platform for connected clinic operations.

How it is being built
Technology should remove wasted work—not remove the people who care.

Automation handles call bursts, redials, routing and documentation drudgery. People remain responsible for empathy, judgment, review and complex decisions.

Human reviewClinicians and billing staff keep final authority.
Minimum necessaryRole-based access and short-lived data by design.
Auditable workConsent, actions and time can be traced.
Fail closedCritical integrations do not silently bypass the EHR.
